richiami.difetto: It has been identified that there is a possibility that a rear axle hub might fracture. Additionally fractures might occur in the clutch housing due to insufficient rigidity of the material.
richiami.modello: MITSUBISHI MOBILE CRANES - VARIOUS , MITSUBISHI MOBILE CRANES - VARIOUS
